page.overview:
Who is Bragarik?

King Bragarik was a powerful Dwarf King who led the first Dwarf army against the rising Waaagh! of Grom the Paunch. Their armies clashed at the Battle of Iron Gate, which while having no clear victor, led to heavy losses for the Dwarfs and was considered a disaster. He would later send emissaries to Emperor Dieter IV to call for aid, but was disgusted by the Emperor's response. The Emperor's cowardice would later make its own entry into the Book of Grudges by the High King himself.
